target_customer: Plaintiffs law firms, and later insurers and compliance teams, paying for early legal violation detection and case sourcing
problem: Legal violations and harmed victims go undetected for years; Darrow scans public data to detect violations, estimate victims and match plaintiff lawyers with cases.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for law firms plus services

founders.name: Evyatar Ben Artzi
prior_employers: Israeli Supreme Court (clerk, per his own interview)
founders.background_notes: Described in a LawNext interview as originating the idea from his Supreme Court clerkship.

founders.name: Gila Hayat
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no background found.

founders.name: Elad Spiegelman
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no background found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mining large unstructured public data sources with NLP to detect violations and estimate victims and case value was hard for a three-founder team in 2020.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated case outcome data and law firm relationships help; similar approaches were copyable with LLMs later.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of incumbents copying the case sourcing wedge; Darrow raised 35 million in 2023 and reported about 170 staff in 2026.

market_need_then: Class action and mass tort plaintiff firms spend heavily on business development to find cases; the company framed a justice gap in which many victims never bring claims.

identity.voice_and_tone: Justice themed, newsroom says its brand tells the story of justice through intelligence

rebrands.to: Legal exposure management and AI lab for legal risk
rebrands.why: Positioning change on the company site and press; the name stayed Darrow

branding.community_and_virality: Press and podcast coverage of the CEO; recognition such as Inc. Best in Business 2025 and an AI Breakthrough award; no merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is memorable and tied to justice, with consistent trade press coverage; the name origin is not confirmed by a source.

pivots.from: Justice intelligence for plaintiff case sourcing
pivots.to: Legal exposure management for law firms, insurers and compliance teams
pivots.why: Company site and 2025 and 2026 press show added underwriting and risk products; reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Darrow raised a reported 20 million in November 2021 and a 35 million Series B in September 2023, and the CEO says about 60 million total and profitability for three years with about 170 staff as of 2026. It grew by selling case sourcing to plaintiff firms and later expanded to insurers. No exit or shutdown found.
notes: The November 2021 round of 20 million is reported by CTech per the YC page and an aggregator; the stage is not stated by a source I opened (CB Insights labels it Series B, one aggregator Series A) so it is recorded as other. Its investors are given as Entree Capital and three others by one source. Sacra lists 2023 total 60M and 2024 revenue 26M, not recorded as rounds; CB Insights shows a 5.28M entry in October 2025 that was not reconciled. A source mentioning a 60M Series B in April 2025 was not corroborated. Competitors list empty: only Justpoint appeared and it is not dated near 2021.
